name: exact-counts
transport: supabase-mcp execute_sql (Management API, SELECT-only, role postgres)
query: select (select count(*) from public.user_event_scores) as user_event_scores_exact_rows, (select count(*) from public.email_reminder_log) as email_reminder_log_exact_rows, (select string_agg(column_name, ',' order by ordinal_position) from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='user_event_scores') as user_event_scores_columns, now() as captured_at
note: Closes the open question from 01-10: user_event_scores is exactly 0 rows (count(*), not n_live_tup) while pg_cron reports compute_user_scores running every 30 minutes with 0 failures; personalized recommendations therefore always take the popularity fallback in production. email_reminder_log is exactly 0 rows.
